# bioexcel/biobb_dna/intrabpcorr

## Summary

Calculate correlation between all intra-base pairs of a single sequence and for a single helical parameter.

Calculate correlation between neighboring base pairs and pairs of helical parameters.

Nextflow adapter of the [IntraBasePairCorrelation](https://biobb-dna.readthedocs.io/en/latest/intrabp_correlations.html#intrabp-correlations-intrabpcorr-module) building block of [biobb_dna](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_dna) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_DNA_INTRABPCORR } from 'bioexcel/biobb_dna/intrabpcorr'

workflow {
    BIOBB_DNA_INTRABPCORR(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_filename_shear` | yes | ser | Path to .ser file with data for helical parameter 'shear' |
| `input_filename_stretch` | yes | ser | Path to .ser file with data for helical parameter 'stretch' |
| `input_filename_stagger` | yes | ser | Path to .ser file with data for helical parameter 'stagger' |
| `input_filename_buckle` | yes | ser | Path to .ser file with data for helical parameter 'buckle' |
| `input_filename_propel` | yes | ser | Path to .ser file with data for helical parameter 'propel' |
| `input_filename_opening` | yes | ser | Path to .ser file with data for helical parameter 'opening' |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_csv_path` | yes | csv | Path to directory where output is saved |
| `output_jpg_path` | yes | jpg | Path to .jpg file where output is saved |
| `versions_biobb_dna` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_dna', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of IntraBasePairCorrelation properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_csv_path: 'csv']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_dna container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_DNA_INTRABPCORR' {
        ext.properties = [remove_tmp: true]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sequence` | string | null | Nucleic acid sequence for the input .ser file. Length of sequence is expected to be the same as the total number of columns in the .ser file, minus the index column (even if later on a subset of columns is selected with the *seqpos* option). |
| `seqpos` | array | null | list of sequence positions (columns indices starting by 0) to analyze. If not specified it will analyse the complete sequence. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
